crossRefs.note: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down…
the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will…
The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies. Isn’t this written…
